# Add or change a FlowOps AWS Action

Read `../../AGENTS.md`, `flowops/providers/aws/AGENTS.md` and the aws-action-development skill. Specify botocore operation/schema, read-only/mutating classification, risk, idempotency, IAM, account/resource validation, simulation/native-DryRun behavior, bounds, errors/retries and deterministic tests. Do not use generic allowlisting to avoid defining necessary safety semantics.
